name: AiLabel
description: an indicator of AI instances that is a pathway to AI explainability
status: beta — implemented and unit-tested in all seven frameworks with an axe-clean demo page; not yet exercised in composed flows
aria: `aria-label={label}` -- provides an accessible name for the AI indicator so screen readers announce its purpose
keyboard: No keyboard interactions — this is a passive element
props: `label`: string (default: "AI") -- accessible name for the indicator via `aria-label`
`text`: string (default: "AI") -- visible text displayed inside the indicator
`...restProps`: unknown -- additional attributes spread onto the `<span>` element
